description: A firm in Frontier Desk's markets directory, by name: what kind of firm it is in plain words, its own site, the relationships held for it (what it bought, backed, lent to or borrowed from, each naming the other party), and a line on its recent activity. Up to eight firms per call. This is the public projection: no internal ids, codes, tags, evidence text or third-party scores cross it, and no client, mandate or engagement is reachable here.

query.description: Part of a firm's name, for example "Monroe" or "CORE Industrial".

name: lookup_firm
title: Look up a firm in the markets directory
